# Hotel Menu Guide — llms.txt

> Independent guides to hotel restaurant menus across the United States:
> what notable hotel restaurants serve, their menus and prices, and how to
> book. Built and maintained by Firoz Khan of FK Digital Media. Not
> affiliated with any hotel or restaurant group.

## What this site does

- 68 hotel restaurant guides across 11 states (New York, Ohio, California,
  Nevada, Illinois, Florida, Texas, Tennessee, Minnesota, South Carolina,
  New Mexico), each covering the restaurant's menu highlights, prices,
  hours, and booking details.
- 11 state pillar pages (e.g. /best-hotel-restaurants-nyc/) grouping each
  state's guides, plus a /states/ index.
- Every guide links the restaurant's official site, official menu (where
  published), and a booking option. Where a restaurant publishes no prices,
  the guide says so plainly instead of guessing.
- Permanently closed restaurants are verified before publishing and replaced
  or flagged — the site does not list dead venues as open.

## Honest limitations (stated on the site itself)

- Prices are labelled with their source and date (official menu PDFs,
  restaurant sites, or dated third-party reports); menus and prices change,
  and readers are told to verify with the restaurant before visiting.
- Menu descriptions are the site's own summaries in original words — full
  menus are never copied verbatim.
- Illustrations are AI-generated and labelled as illustrative artwork, not
  photographs of the restaurants' actual dishes.
- Awards and credentials are attributed to the awarding body; the site does
  not invent reviews, awards, or opening hours.
